g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
view-what-an-environment-resolves-to.md): Resolve an environment to the exact execution inputs a run would use right now: the host
's current config, the closed server set (including servers contributed by pinned plugin versions), and the resolved plugin versio
ns. Returns 409 when the environment cannot currently produce a runnable configura…\n- [Get or create an unnamed environment for a
composed stack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/get-or-create-an-unnamed-environment-for-a-composed-stack.md):
GET-OR-CREATE an UNNAMED, content-addressed environment for a composed stack — a host plus an optional server group, model overri
de, computer image and pinned skills.\n- [Promote an unnamed environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/promo
te-an-unnamed-environment.md): Give an UNNAMED (ad-hoc) environment a name, promoting it IN PLACE — the same environment, now a pe
rmanent entry in the project's list, with the same id every existing run still points at.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/archive-an-environment.md): Archive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and
frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restored — this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE.
Requires `expectedRevision` — the revision you last read. If the environment changed since, the write is re…\n- [Restore an archiv
ed environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/restore-an-archived-environment.md): Restore an archived enviro
nment. Returns 409 if another live environment took its name in the meantime. Plugin pins whose version row no longer exists at al
l are dropped on the way back to live — compare the returned `pluginVersionIds` against what you archived to detect that. Requires
`expectedRevi…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The s
tudies published from this project — name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environment fo
r user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, because
publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment returns the existing one rath
er than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studi
es/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Deliberately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an organizati
on that loses the flag must still be able to take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studie
s/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share
link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure — but not both in one call. **
Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the st
udy live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scena
rios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowl
ist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored
blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-executi
on-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something as a set
, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share
link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from g
ranting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/
invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n-
[Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVe
rsion` and cuts off any session that member already had — it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a
different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the s
tudy's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alternative — unpublish and repu
blish — mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/stud
ies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current window sig
nals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extracted from the current window —
and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studie
s/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones included — dismissal is a state on th
e finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md)
: Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/stud
ies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the
study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run
and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finish
ed one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable
remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Restore a
dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal. Bodyless: th
e path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a
relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `
url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence is a deliber…\n- [Revoke a tun
nel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant at the control
plane and edge: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server record — includin
g its now-dead `url` — is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.\n- [List a proje
ct's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/list-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (installed, non-uninstalled) Age
nt Plugins in the project, disabled ones included (marked `enabled: false`). Read-only: import, activation, enable/disable and uni
nstall are app flows, not API operations.\n- [Get a plugin version](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/get-a-plugin-ver
sion.md): One imported plugin version with its component projections: declared MCP servers (placement, auth timing, materialized s
